blind.description: A stylized medieval/fantasy hanging wall sign designed for a shop. It features a horizontal light-brown wooden post mounted via a dark grey metal wall bracket on one end, with two metal straps holding a suspended shield-shaped sign. The sign has a dark reddish-brown rim, cream wood grain backing, and a painted golden star with an eye emblem in the center. All geometry is solid, smooth, and continuous.
blind.from_above: A straight horizontal wooden beam with a rounded outer tip, two dark metal bands around it, and a rectangular metal mounting plate at the left end.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 to 2.5 feet tall and roughly 2.5 to 3 feet wide, about one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
